author: Second Wind
description:
Normally the narrative of a TTRPG is up to the players. But what happens when game mechanics start giving or taking away that control? Jenna Stoeber and Jesse Galena talk about it, take your questions, and make goofs.

If you dig watching us check out indies, considering supporting us over at Patreon -- https://www.patreon.com/SecondWindGroup

Check out our new merch store over at DFTBA -- https://store.dftba.com/collections/second-wind
title: When Mechanics Control the Narrative w/ Jenna Stoeber | RPG Help Desk
